title: Quantifying sensitivity of PM2.5 mass to ammonia and nitrate availability in Hong Kong based on four-year hourly measurements
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,565-578
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00114E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zijing Zhang, Jian Zhen Yu
Nitrate and ammonium are major components of inorganic PM2.5 in Hong Kong. Our study shows that synergistic control of NOx and NH3 can effectively cut down PM2.5 in Hong Kong.
